properties.Description: Links a type descriptor to the schema that contains it.
Inverse of ComponentOf, from a schema to its type descriptors.
Connects a type descriptor to the property descriptors in its instance contract.
Inverse of InstanceProperties, from a property descriptor to the type descriptors whose instance contracts include it.
Connects a type descriptor to the declared relationship descriptors in its instance contract.
Inverse of InstanceRelationships, from a declared relationship descriptor to the type descriptors whose instance contracts include it.
Links every holon, including a descriptor holon, to the concrete type descriptor that describes it.
Inverse of DescribedBy, from a type descriptor to the holons it directly describes.
Identifies the current holon space that owns a holon; infrastructure supplies this relationship.
Inverse of OwnedBy, from a holon space to the holons it owns.
Specifies the single value-type descriptor governing values of a property descriptor.
Inverse of ValueType, from a value-type descriptor to the property descriptors it governs.
Specifies the holon-type constraint for sources of a relationship descriptor.
Inverse of SourceType, from a holon-type descriptor to relationship descriptors that use it as their source constraint.
Specifies the holon-type constraint for targets of a relationship descriptor.
Inverse of TargetType, from a holon-type descriptor to relationship descriptors that use it as their target constraint.
Pairs each declared relationship descriptor with its authoritative inverse relationship descriptor.
Links an inverse relationship descriptor to its authoritative declared relationship descriptor.
Declares the allowed symbolic variant descriptors of an enum value type.
Inverse of Variants, from an enum variant descriptor to its owning enum value-type descriptor.
Indicates that one schema holon depends on another.
Inverse of DependsOn, indicating which schemas depend on this schema.
Specifies the value-type descriptor governing elements of a value-array type.
Inverse of ElementValueType, from a value-type descriptor to value-array descriptors that use it as their element type.
Establishes optional single-parent descriptor specialization.
Inverse of Extends, from a parent descriptor to its direct subtype descriptors.
Supplies the ordered property descriptors used as positional parameters in a format key rule template.
Inverse of TemplateParameters, from a property descriptor to format key rules that use it as a positional parameter.
Declares the transaction model afforded by a holon space.
Inverse of AffordsTransactionModel, from a transaction model to the holon space that affords it.
Contains the holons carried by a persisted collection holon.
Inverse of CollectionMembers, from a member holon to persisted collections containing it.
Declares the holon-type descriptor accepted as the element type of a persisted collection.
Inverse of ElementType, from a holon-type descriptor to persisted collection types that use it as their element constraint.
Links a holon version to the immediately preceding version in its lineage; infrastructure supplies this relationship.
Inverse of Predecessor, from a holon version to later versions derived directly from it.
